page.overview:
Who is Rod Reiss?

Rod, like his daughter, was a rather short person. Though, unlike his daughter, he was a slightly overweight man with a round face, short black hair and a thin black mustache. He was typically seen wearing the clothes of a wealthy man, featuring a white button-front shirt with a black pullover vest, loose black pants and black dress shoes. However, when conducting the Titan rituals Rod wore a white shirt and pants with a long coat, as did the other Reiss males during family meetings.

In this form, Rod was an abnormal Titan. His appearance as a Titan retained practically nothing of his human form, except for still being male-like as most Titans are. He grew to the point of becoming one of the largest Titans ever known, reaching in total ( at the withers), twice as large as the Colossus Titan, which is 60 meters in height.

However, his body was quite disproportionate, having a large torso with a small head, and very thin limbs for his size, thus being unable to stand up and needing to crawl on all fours. He was also notably skeletal, with most of his bones clearly visible and lacking in muscles.

Rod's titan form also lacked a face. It had been destroyed by the sheer friction of him dragging it along the ground as he moved. The damage was so great that even the titan's brains were exposed. Had he not been dragging his face along the ground constantly, his face would have been able to regenerate at a normal rate.
